headline: Mercado Libre Posts Q3 Net Income of $448 Million as Margins Contract
summary: Mercado Libre reported third-quarter net income of $448 million, up about 6% year-over-year. However, profit margins declined due to seller discounts, free shipping costs, and logistics expansion.
why: Mercado Libre is Latin America's leading e-commerce and fintech ecosystem, making its financial results a key bellwether for regional consumer demand and tech sector performance.

impacts.name: MercadoLibre
impacts.why: Lower profit margins and bottom-line misses typically pressure the company's stock in after-hours trading.

why_moved: Disappointing profit margins driven by high operational and logistics expenses weighed on investor sentiment, causing the stock to decline in after-hours trading.
